C0033.title: Judicial Determination Case on Producing and Selling Flash-Sale Sniping Software
C0033.summary: Jiangsu procuratorial case material titled the matter as a judicial-determination case on producing and selling flash-sale sniping software, discussing Wang's development and sale of the 'HiRoot' tool for Taobao flash-sale purchases. The case is used to explain that such software may involve criminal risks related to providing programs or tools for intrusion into or illegal control of computer information systems, and that automation tools in popular-product purchase scenarios can disrupt platform transaction order.
